verify.title: Verify diagnosis integrity
verify.subtitle: Public SHA-256 check — no login, no personal data on this page.
verify.notFound: No attestation found for this hash.
verify.invalid: Hash mismatch — stored payload does not re-hash to this value.
verify.valid: Integrity recorded — SHA-256 hash confirmed (payload re-hashes to the stored content hash).
verify.onChain: On-chain proof: Not yet anchored (coming in a future update)
verify.onChainConfirmed: On-chain confirmed — Merkle root anchored on chain
verify.onChainPending: On-chain pending (daily batch) — expected until the next ProofChain anchor run. Not an error.
verify.onChainPendingHint: Integrity is already verified above. Blockchain anchoring runs on a daily batch schedule and does not affect the SHA-256 check.
verify.missingHash: Add ?h=<content_hash> to the URL to verify a diagnosis.
